definitions.gloss: arrogance; conceit; overestimation of oneself; presumption
definitions.explanation: An inflated sense of one's own abilities or importance. Having an exaggerated opinion of oneself that goes beyond what is warranted.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}い{上|あ}がりだ。
{思|おも}い{上|あ}がり⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{甚|はなは}だしい→甚だしい：13520_hanahadashii⟧。
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}い{上|あ}がり⟦ではないか→ではないか：30627_dehanaika⟧。
examples.english: Isn't it arrogant to think that only you are right?

notes:
The noun form of the verb {思|おも}い{上|あ}がる (to be conceited; to have an inflated opinion of oneself). Both the noun and the verb are strongly negative, implying the person lacks self-awareness about their actual standing or abilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{上|あ}がり⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{甚|はなは}だしい→甚だしい：13520_hanahadashii⟧: extremely arrogant
- {思|おも}い{上|あ}がった⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a conceited attitude
- {思|おも}い{上|あ}がるな: don't get full of yourself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高飛車|たかびしゃ}→高飛車：14947_takabisha⟧: high-handed; overbearing — emphasizes bossy, domineering behavior toward others
- ⟦{傲慢|ごうまん}→傲慢：07635_gouman⟧: arrogance; haughtiness — a more formal, literary term for arrogance
- うぬぼれ: vanity; conceit — focuses on excessive self-admiration, especially regarding appearance or charm
- {自惚|うぬぼ}れ: vanity — the kanji form of the same word
